status: exploratory bounded follow-up; prior gene/global results already known
primary_score: Within each contrast, standardize each measured gene across its samples, then average gene z-scores within the predefined set. Report exposed-minus-control score and fraction of genes with agreeing expression change. This is a gene-set expression score, not biochemical activation.
sensitivity: Mean log1p expression shift with global-gene shift subtracted
Leave one sample or paired donor/cell-line out
coverage: At least 50% of mapped canonical pathway genes observed and >=10 genes; also report fraction of original published set retained. For cross-flight pathway comparison require a common observed gene subset.
scope: All existing 54 general-survey contrasts plus two repeat-flight pool contrasts. Report mouse muscle grouped by four missions; human analogs kept separate. New onboard-1g studies GSE224805/GSE157937 analyzed separately, requiring >=99% canonical coverage for primary model inference.
new_controls: MG63 microgravity versus onboard 1g (3+3). HMEC1 microgravity versus onboard 1g (3+2), onboard 1g versus Earth (2+3), microgravity versus Earth (3+3). Shared controls make these contrasts dependent; no pure radiation attribution.
no_claims: No significance testing, classifier training, or novelty claim; study-specific biology, gene-set overlap and source normalization remain caveats.

input_source_amendment_before_results.MG63: All six author sample-count columns primary; NCBI raw counts for five matched GSMs as processing sensitivity. One GSM missing from NCBI export; no fabricated sample.
input_source_amendment_before_results.HMEC1: All eight NCBI raw-count samples primary, replacing the filtered 70%-coverage CPM matrix. The published CPM table will be used for source sensitivity where genes overlap.
input_source_amendment_before_results.robust_highlight_rule: Score direction retained for every leave-one-unit-out recomputation, agreeing sign in within-sample rank score and background-centered mean-log-expression score. Gene coherence reported separately; no significance threshold.
